libraryStatus: A staged RPSGT V3 source map records a Guild Drive copy and 43 mapped sections for infant PSG visual/developmental support. Private Drive access remains internal and is not exposed to learners.
apaCitation: Crowell, D. H., & CHIME Study Group. (2003). An atlas of infant polysomnography. The Parthenon Publishing Group.
bestFor: Infant PSG signal acquisition, setup, signal quality, sleep-state/stage recognition, arousals, ECG context, pediatric respiratory-event recognition, oxygenation context, report organization, quality review, and artifact recognition.
authorityBoundary: Historical/developmental visual support only. Current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 infant/pediatric staging, respiratory, arousal, cardiac, technical, and reporting rules govern scoring and technical decisions; ICSD-3-TR controls current diagnostic classification; current AAST guidance and facility policy govern procedures, safety, and response. Legacy values and thresholds in this 2003 atlas must not override current standards.
copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, section titles, page locators, and original Sleep Pathways Guild study directions only. Do not reproduce proprietary figures, tracings, tables, images, or substantial protected prose.
